thread:
alana (growth): Quick heads-up — reallocating some paid search budget into retargeting for the next 7 days to boost webinar signups. Need creative refresh + landing check.

mike (paid search): @sophie can you push two new creatives? I'll shift ~30% of non-branded search spend into the retarget pool starting tomorrow. Landing UTM: https://rwd.in/wbnr-utms

sophie (content): On it. Two variants: short benefit + CTA, and testimonial + CTA. Will upload to Ads > creatives by EOD. :white_check_mark:

josh (analytics): Heads-up — conversion lag from search -> signup historically ~48h. Recommend holding large bid changes for 24h to avoid noisy signals.

alana (growth): Good call. Also need inbound lead routing to #webinar-inbound and SFDC owner assignment. @lina can you confirm webhook + mapping?

lina (ops): webhook created: `POST /webhooks/marketing/webinar_signup` -> slack #webinar-inbound. SFDC rule: assign owner when `utm_campaign` contains "webinar-apr". Running test payload now.

campaign-bot: Budget shuffle scheduled: 30% shift brand_search -> retarget_pool between 2026-04-05 09:00 and 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC.

mike (paid search): Bid rules: daypart +15% 08:00-11:00 PT, cap max CPC $4.50, auto-pause creatives with CTR <1%. Also enabling frequency cap on retarget to 6 impressions/day.

sophie (content): Uploaded assets: `ad_0427_shortCTA.jpg` and `ad_0427_testimonial.mp4`. Creative notes: match webinar header, keep CTA phrasing identical to landing page. Avoid the word "free" because of policy quirks.

josh (analytics): Building quick dashboard (CPL, CTR, conv rate w/ 7d lag, sessions -> webinar landing). Will share link in 2h. Also setting cohort window to 7/14/30d for attribution.

alana (growth): Let's run a 48h headline A/B: "Ship LLM features faster" vs "Cut inference cost by 3x" — winner scales. If CPL below target after 24h, scale daily +10% until spend cap.

mike (paid search): Reminder: disable the overlap audience test in retargeting before scaling to prevent double-serving. Also added a negative keyword refresh for non-intent queries.

sophie (content): Small copy tweak pushed: CTA -> "Reserve your seat" (consistent with webinar page). Uploaded final variants to the campaign. :rocket:

alana (growth): Thanks everyone. Check back in 24h with first signals. If we see >15% CTR lift, we move variant to primary and notify sales for priority outreach.

josh (analytics): Test payload returned successful, webhook verified. Sharing dashboard link in channel once charts populate.

lina (ops): SFDC mapping tested with staging records ✅. Live flip scheduled at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

mike (paid search): I'll monitor hourly and post a quick recap at +12h. :mag_right:
